title: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
title_zh: Piccolo：通过递归自我改进推动决策模型与数据协同演化
abstract_en: We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). The models predict probabilities over candidate answers for general-purpose text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive games. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59, while Piccolo-9B and Piccolo-4B achieve 68.35 and 67.46, respectively. All three rank first on the Private benchmark in their respective model-size categories. Research agents analyze model behavior, construct training data, conduct experiments, and use the results to refine subsequent proposals. Semantic slices and a shared research memory connect these actions across the model family's development. With training recipes comprising hundreds of thousands of examples, data selection and feedback-driven refinement are central to the self-improvement process. Our large-scale RSI exploration yields three counter-intuitive insights for decision-model development: (1) Backbone-recipe co-adaptation outweighs raw model recency: earlier backbones can surpass newer generations on visual tasks under identical recipes; (2) Targeted data curation enables 4B-9B models to rival 27B baselines on specialized workflows; and (3) Continuous loss reduction can decouple from and even degrade discrete decision accuracy. Together with the released weights and tools from the Data-Juicer and AgentScope ecosystems, Piccolo provides an actionable blueprint for building frontier decision models and scaling data-driven RSI.
abstract_zh: Piccolo 是一系列参数规模从 0.8B 到 27B 的多模态决策模型。它通过 Agentic Data Engineering（智能体驱动的数据工程）和递归自我改进（RSI），让模型能力与训练数据协同演化。模型为候选答案预测概率，适用于通用文本与视觉判断、智能体运行框架、数据工作流及交互式游戏。研究智能体分析模型行为、构建训练数据、开展实验，再依据结果修订下一轮方案；语义切片和共享研究记忆将这些环节串联起来。在使用数十万条样本的训练方案中，数据筛选和基于反馈的迭代是自我改进的核心。Piccolo-27B 以 75.59 分登顶 Decision Index Vision Full 榜单，Piccolo-9B 和 Piccolo-4B 分别获得 68.35 和 67.46 分；三者均在 Private 基准各自的参数规模组别中排名第一。作者发布了模型权重及 Data-Juicer 和 AgentScope 生态中的相关工具。
key_points_zh: RSI 将行为分析、数据构建、实验验证和下一轮方案修订连成闭环，并通过语义切片与共享研究记忆积累经验。
骨干模型与训练方案的匹配比模型代际更新更重要：在同一训练方案下，较早的骨干模型也可能在视觉任务中胜过更新一代。
有针对性地筛选训练数据，可让 4B–9B 模型在专门工作流中媲美 27B 基线。
训练损失持续下降并不保证离散决策准确率上升，后者甚至可能下降。

Standardized records support cross-branch retrieval; lineage tracks model ancestry and
reused recipes or findings. Memory associates gains and regressions with slices and settings, guiding
experiments from other starting models.
